final: SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_pressratio, AVG(avg_size_per_min) AS avg_of_avg_size_per_min FROM (SELECT s.zoneref, st.typesite, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(s.gbsize / s.spanmin) AS avg_size_per_min FROM scans s JOIN sites st ON st.zoneregistry = s.zoneref WHERE s.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND s.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.zoneref, st.typesite)
